'''Braka''' was an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] guild leader and [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forger]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. Braka worked with [[Restria Venteger]] to engineer a [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] [[Miner/Legends|miner]] strike to embarrass the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Henris Octavian]].<ref name="Game" />
